owner_api.product_invocation: collector installs at capture startup, joins the latest post-original raw controller callback to the hourly early-render selected Present, writes a37_raw_controller_selected_present.json once, and uninstalls at collector teardown
owner_api.pbp2_authority: none; the evidence owner cannot call the production seal while activation and scheduling are false

required_cases.proof_scope: positive current, negative exact change, open/visible controller, selected record/range present, selected-Present QPC join
negative current, positive exact change, open/visible controller, selected record/range present, selected-Present QPC join

case_output_handling: Run each case in a fresh process/output directory and retain a37_raw_controller_selected_present.json under the required case filename before regrading.
required_join: controller open byte equals GUI-visible bit
post-materialization QPC is not after selected Present
raw receipt selected-Present digest equals the production selector receipt
PBP2 is not emitted and activation remains false
promotion_rule: A passing receipt closes only the raw controller spine. It cannot promote d74. Full exact runtime producers for every unavailable semantic field, a complete PBP2 selected-Present fixture, root Final/All and replay parity remain required before any latch or registry promotion.
